recurring_rule_shape.name: recurring_rule_shape
recurring_rule_shape.value:
("recurring_rule"."type" = 'transfer' and "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" is not null and "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" <> "recurring_rule"."wallet_id" and "recurring_rule"."category_id" is null)
      or ("recurring_rule"."type" <> 'transfer' and "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" is null and "recurring_rule"."to_amount" is null and "recurring_rule"."category_id" is not null)

transaction_shape.name: transaction_shape
transaction_shape.value:
("transaction"."type" = 'transfer' and "transaction"."to_wallet_id" is not null and "transaction"."to_wallet_id" <> "transaction"."wallet_id" and "transaction"."category_id" is null)
      or ("transaction"."type" <> 'transfer' and "transaction"."to_wallet_id" is null and "transaction"."to_amount" is null)
